title: Spicy Korean Chicken Tagine
description: A fusion of Korean and North African flavors, this spicy chicken tagine is a hearty and aromatic dish. Serve over steamed rice or couscous.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken thighs and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the gochujang, chili flakes, and tagine spice blend. Stir to combine.
Add the carrots and potatoes. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the tagine and cook over low heat for 30-40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve the tagine over steamed rice or couscous.
